meta.title: 1% is two places left
meta.summary: SAMPLE 1% of 8,500 and 10% of 470: shift the decimal, do not divide by guessing.

success.message:
Session complete. 1% = two places left; 10% = one place.

SAMPLE: 1% of 8,500=85, 10% of 470=47.

start.message:
SAMPLE: 1% of 8,500 in a fee chat.

Which motion is 1%?

choices.label: Move the decimal two places left
Divide 8,500 by 8 because percent feels like eighths

wrong_start_one.message:
10% is one place. 1% is two places. Mixing them off-by-tens the answer.

Return to the shift rule.

wrong_start_divide_8.message:
Percent is per hundred, not per eight. Shift two places for 1%.

Return to the shift rule.

apply.message:
Two places left on 8,500.

What is 1%?

wrong_apply_850.message:
850 would be 10%. 1% of 8,500 is 85.

Revisit the two-place move.

wrong_apply_8_5.message:
Three places is 0.1%. Stop at two.

Revisit the two-place move.

ten.message:
Now 10% of 470. One place left.

What is it?

choices.label: 470 — 10% of a number is the number

wrong_ten_4_7.message:
4.7 is 1% of 470. 10% is one place: 47.

Try 10% again.

wrong_ten_470.message:
That would be 100%. One place left from 470 is 47.

Try 10% again.
